title: Inspection fee — internal combustion engines (per Hp bracket)
notes: Annual inspection fee per engine/machine, bracketed by horsepower; evaluated per unit by the engine. Paid upon application of the permit, not later than 15 days after actual inspection; thereafter within 20 days of January or of every quarter (Sec. 3N.02). Brackets normalized to integer Hp with boundary Hp assigned per the printed 'xHp and below' rows (3Hp->250, 5Hp->250, 10Hp->300, 14Hp->400).
defects: Sec. 3N.01(a) printed brackets jump from '2Hp and below' to 'not lower than 3Hp', leaving 2-3Hp unassigned; normalized so the 200.00 row covers below 3Hp (extract [?] note, PDF 110).
Sec. 3N.01(a) row 5 printed 'Above 15Hp' (vs. subsection (b)'s 'Above 14Hp'), leaving 15Hp unassigned; normalized to above 14Hp per (b) so 15Hp takes 500.00 (extract [?] note, PDF 110).

title: Inspection fee — other stationary engines or machines (per Hp bracket)

title: Certificate of Environment Clearance (CEC)
notes: Headline CEC fee ('Same schedule as Inspection Fees'). Applies to business, industrial, commercial or agricultural establishments with minimum capitalization of Php100,000 and other establishments (Sec. 3W.01). CEC or Certificate of Non-Coverage (NCC) issued only after compliance with Malabon CENRO environmental requirements and payment of fees. Annual environmental protection and preservation fee; payable on or before January 20 (Sec. 3W.06). Same-nature/same-type businesses of one owner in one barangay: only the higher/highest rate is imposed (Sec. 3W.02; FeeCalculator implements the dedup). Different-nature businesses at one address pay separate fees per business.
